description: Digital Logbook — blockchain-verified personal flight record

hard_stops.label: Duplicate Flight Entry
hard_stops.logic: Duplicate flight entry detected — same date, route, and aircraft

hard_stops.label: Time Categories Invalid
hard_stops.logic: Flight time categories do not sum correctly

soft_flags.label: Unverified Import
soft_flags.logic: Imported flight data pending pilot review and verification

soft_flags.label: Dispatch Record Discrepancy
soft_flags.logic: Manual entry differs from dispatch record by >15 minutes

soft_flags.label: Flight Hour Milestone Approaching
soft_flags.logic: Approaching flight hour milestone (e.g., 1000h, ATP minimums)

chat_rules.message: Never state cumulative flight time or currency totals as fact unless computed from logbook entries present in this session. If entries are absent or incomplete, say so rather than estimating.

Before confirming a flight entry as logged, check for a duplicate-entry match (same date/route/aircraft) and for a dispatch-record discrepancy over 15 minutes. Surface either as a flag on the entry, not silently.

Never describe an entry as chain-verified/anchored/immutable until it has actually completed the real anchoring pipeline (batch assigned and confirmed). Before that, describe it as recorded and pending anchor, not already verified.
